page.overview:
What is Family Burger Restaurant?

The restaurant is also implied to be a fast food chain, as a seemingly different location is shown as the meet-up spot for the Weapon Hybrids.

Family Burger seems to be a relatively small, L-shaped, one-story restaurant with a parking lot.

The restaurant's name and logo is placed all along the top of the restaurant and a giant version of the restaurant's mascot is placed right above the entrance.

As a family-owned fast food restaurant known best for their burgers, the restaurant is appropriately named “Family Burger”, which is written in a font similar to Zoinks Warm.
